title: lucy common definitions
description: Shared definitions for lucy's own resource kinds (lucy/v1alpha1). Metadata is the ai-sdlc metadata object with namespace required: the namespace names the Airspace (org).

apiVersion.description: lucy's own API version. It never uses the ai-sdlc.io prefix (spec section 10.1).

status.description: Observed state. lucy records it in its database and never writes it into config files.
